description: Build reusable agentic workloads. Explore alternatives and check results with serverless execution on Recurse. Expose as MCP or run to completion.

defaultPrompt: Design a Python tool that tests code changes against a benchmark.
Plan a Recurse agent that generates puzzle levels and checks solvability.
Help me expose a tested Recurse agent through MCP.
interface.longDescription: Your coding agent uses Recurse to define Python tools and checks around a task. An LLM calls those tools to explore alternatives and refine results. Execution is serverless: expose the workload as an MCP server for use in agentic workflows, or run it to completion. Requires the Recurse SDK and a Recurse account.

name: recurse
